gumtree_entries.description:
ADDED i2: Tests for {@link DayOfYear}.

The EvoSuite mock clock used by this test suite is fixed so that "today" is the 45th day of the year. Every assertion that expe
ADDED i3: The day-of-year reported by the fixed mock clock used throughout these tests.
ADDED i5: A ZoneOffset carries no day-of-year information, so the conversion fails.
ADDED i7: HijrahDate does not use the ISO calendar system, so adjustment is rejected.
ADDED i9: Adjusting a LocalDate already on day 45 leaves it unchanged.
ADDED i10: A query that returns the same DayOfYear is passed through unchanged.
ADDED i11: 366 is not a leap year, so day 366 cannot exist in it.
ADDED i12: -488 is a leap year, so day 366 is valid.
ADDED i13: Any day below 366 is valid for every year, leap or not.
ADDED i16: A non-ISO date is converted to a LocalDate before extracting the day-of-year.
ADDED i17: from() on an existing DayOfYear returns an equivalent instance.
ADDED i18: ZoneOffset.MAX shifts the clock to the previous day, giving a different day-of-year.
